name: image_layout
description: One pass over an image: container type, E01 acquisition record, the partition table in sectors, and each volume's file system, cluster size and serial. Returns the -o offset every other command needs.

image.description: Path to the image (raw, split raw's first segment, or E01)

sector_size.description: Force a sector size in bytes when the container does not say (512 or 4096)
